_doc: Koi Blossom registration as DATA (engine/digitize/extract/register.py), engine trial 2026-10-20 (tag koi). flat = the front-view mockup inputs/front.png (770 x 1088 px). View F (fronts, size M): x mm = (px - 368) * 1.12, y mm = (py - 308) * 510/475 -- the same constants as projects/koi-blossom-hoodie/mockmap.py (CF zip x = 368 px, CF neck seam y = 308 px, hem-band seam y = 783 px = 510 mm). Garment mm: x from CF (+ = wearer's left), y from the CF neck seam; FR (wearer's right front) has x < 0. Close-up fr_upper = inputs/closeup_mockup_koi.png (FR upper panel); its tie points are the 10 features read off both images in trace/closeup_reg.json (lily centres + fish head / tail points; input pixels only, LESSONS A14). Under one global affine they drift 13 mm on average, so the thin-plate spline bends the close-up onto the mockup positions (smoothed, anchored by the affine outside the close-up). region = the close-up's affine footprint in mockup px.
